image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) curled up on a gray stone surface. The salamander displays the characteristic black and yellow warning coloration with irregular yellow spots and bands on a glossy black body. The body is robust and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The head is broad with visible eyes, and the tail is curled around the body. The skin appears smooth and moist with a glossy texture.
